commands.title: Capture app screenshot
commands.description: Capture PNG image content for an agent to attach in chat. Viewport captures the 3D scene; workspace captures the visible app with account dialogs and input fields omitted. No upload or chat message is sent automatically.

commands.title: Record shadow state
commands.description: Append a sanitized visibility, floor and shader diagnostic snapshot to the browser-tab error log.

commands.title: Open error logs
commands.description: Open recent error and rendering logs in Preferences.

commands.title: Read error logs
commands.description: Read up to 200 sanitized browser-tab entries; no credentials or request bodies.

commands.title: Export error logs
commands.description: Return sanitized error-log JSON for review. Does not upload or download.

commands.title: Download error logs
commands.description: Download sanitized error-log JSON locally; no remote upload.

commands.title: Clear error logs
commands.description: Clear this account browser-tab error log.

commands.title: Inspect account
commands.description: Return the current account identity without credentials or session tokens.

commands.title: Verify active account session
commands.description: Recheck the signed-in account against the server. Revoked/reset sessions return to the login gate; unchanged verified identity does not interrupt the workspace.

commands.title: Password reset help
commands.description: Explain the active administrator-assisted password reset method. Does not send an email or reset a password.

commands.title: Request password recovery
commands.description: Request a one-time recovery email for an approved account. Returns the same response for unapproved or unknown addresses.

commands.title: Open account sign-in
commands.description: Open the account dialog for interactive sign-in. Does not complete sign-in; credentials must be entered by the user.

commands.title: Request an account
commands.description: Open an interactive account request form. Submitting requires user confirmation in the form.

commands.title: Open account administration
commands.description: Open administrator requests and approvals. Approval passwords are entered interactively.

commands.title: Review account approval
commands.description: Open one account request for interactive approval. The administrator enters the initial password and confirms in the dialog.

commands.title: List account requests
commands.description: List account requests for a verified administrator.

commands.title: Reject account request
commands.description: Reject one pending account request. Administrator authorization is checked on the server.

commands.title: List user accounts
commands.description: List verified administrator account management entries, without credentials.

commands.title: Revoke user access
commands.description: Explicitly revoke a non-administrator account and block old app sessions. Saved files remain owned by the user.

commands.title: Restore user access
commands.description: Explicitly restore a revoked account. Old app sessions stay invalid.

commands.title: Open password reset
commands.description: Open a verified administrator password reset form for a user. The administrator enters and confirms the password interactively; no password is accepted by commands or macros.

commands.title: Sign out
commands.description: Sign out of the current account and revoke its refresh session. Device files remain local.

commands.title: Unfold FEFCO box
commands.description: Replace a generated folded box with its saved flat dieline, preserving its current dominant liner and edge material. Uses saved design dimensions; object scaling must be reset first. Adds red cut and dashed blue score guides. Undo restores the box and previous profile. Does not unfold arbitrary imported meshes or publish.

commands.title: Animate box folding
commands.description: Animate the selected box along its original CAD folds. Auto-fit eases from the current camera, follows the selected box and settles at the endpoint; Advance Animation camera keyframes or auto-fit Off preserve manual framing. Viewport interaction takes camera control. Returns when playback starts; inspect completion with packaging.fefco.playback.inspect. Preserves materials; completion adds one Undo step. Cancel restores the original. Unscaled generated geometry required.

commands.title: Set automatic folding camera
commands.description: Enable smooth auto-fit and object following for fold/unfold, or preserve manual framing. Saved Advance Animation camera keyframes take priority. Undo supported; setting persists in the session timeline.

commands.title: Control box folding
commands.description: Pause, resume or cancel active folding playback. Available while playback blocks ordinary editing. Cancel restores the original object.

commands.title: Inspect box folding
commands.description: Read folding playback state, progress and stage. Completion produces a normal savable scene object.

commands.title: Check board folding clearance
commands.description: Audit the selected generated FEFCO box or dieline full fold/unfold route with finite-caliper solid surface detection, at no more than one degree per hinge between samples. Returns clear, checked samples, mm tolerance and intersecting panel pairs. Does not mutate the model. Original generated paths and unscaled geometry required; checks this box panels, not other scene objects.

commands.title: Inspect box dimensions
commands.description: Read the selected box nominal/minimum inside and nominal/maximum outside dimensions in mm, board caliper, flap-layer allowances and dimensional tolerance. Open flap sweep is excluded from outside envelope.

commands.title: Choose box dimension basis
commands.description: Switch the selected-box editable dimension panel between minimum usable inside and maximum assembled outside dimensions. Does not change geometry.

commands.title: Update box dimensions
commands.description: Update a generated unscaled box or dieline immediately using inside or outside dimensions in mm. Caliper and actual flap-layer count determine the assembled envelope. Tolerance is a ± reserve per overall dimension, not a supplier-certified production allowance. Preserves current materials, placement and object ID; regenerates the profile; supports Undo.

commands.title: Generate box preset
commands.description: Immediately generate a supported FEFCO preset using current draft dimensions and caliper, optionally overridden together in canonical mm. Validates the complete dimension set before generation. Repairs partial-overlap settings when switching to OSC. Adds and selects a new box with Undo; uses the same service as catalog cards.

commands.title: Read FEFCO catalog
commands.description: Read the initial 02 slotted styles (0200 HSC, 0201 RSC, 0202 OSC, 0203 FOL) and planned families. Includes reference and generation availability.

commands.title: Inspect FEFCO dimensions
commands.description: Read configured FEFCO dimensions/caliper in canonical mm and their interpretation. Board-catalog generation uses CAD score spans; legacy inputs retain their reported interpretation.

commands.title: Configure FEFCO box
commands.description: Select a supported style or change draft generation parameters in millimeters. Length must be at least width. Does not change scene geometry; generate explicitly.

commands.title: Generate folded FEFCO box
commands.description: Create a textured, thick-walled corrugated box using internal dimensions in mm and known scene units. Uses current configured values for omitted fields. 0200 has no top flaps; other styles support open/closed. 0202 requires overlap > 0 and < width. Stores parameters and editable concept dieline, replaces current profile, supports Undo. No upload or publication.

commands.title: Open CAD Measurement layer
commands.description: Open Packaging Designer directly to its interactive Measurement layer. Does not apply edits or change geometry.

commands.title: Choose Packaging Designer layer
commands.description: Switch an open Packaging Designer between Drawing tools and Measurement layer. Does not change geometry.

commands.title: Inspect CAD Measurement layer
commands.description: Read authoritative CAD point distances, inside/outside allowance formulas, independent dimension modes, worst-case intervals and portable material records. Never measures rendered geometry.

commands.title: Show CAD measurements
commands.description: Set visibility of the saved Measurement layer on the CAD drawing. Undo supported.

commands.title: Drive a CAD dimension
commands.description: Edit one independent CAD measurement in canonical mm. Auto reads geometry; Manual drives once; Parametric holds its target on material updates. Inside/outside use material allowance factors. Rebuilds matching generated boxes atomically; custom segments move their endpoint. Undo supported; conflicting constraints rejected.

commands.title: Update board engineering specification
commands.description: Update the active portable board record, including measured caliper, component paper calipers, process tolerances and L/W/H allowance factors. Parametric dimensions retain their targets; manual dimensions follow the resulting CAD. Preserves original engineering precision and records Undo. User-calibrated does not imply certification.

commands.title: Activate board record
commands.description: Select an existing per-design material record and recalculate parametric dimensions. Undo supported.

commands.title: Duplicate board record
commands.description: Copy the active board specification into a new unique per-design record and activate it. Records travel in saved profiles/sessions. Undo supported.

commands.title: Open selected packaging dieline
commands.description: Open the Packaging Designer CAD with the selected box or board saved cut/score profile. Loading a different profile adds one Undo step; opening the matching drawing adds none. Opens an interactive dialog; does not change the 3D solid.

commands.title: Apply CAD to 3D
commands.description: Replace the linked packaging object from canonical CAD, preserving identity and materials with Undo. Auto preserves supported fold state; custom edited folds require explicit flat mode.

commands.title: Choose CAD tool
commands.description: Activate the default selection arrow or point-to-point pen. Finish/cancel a pending path before switching.

commands.title: Assign selected CAD lines
commands.description: Assign cut or crease to all selected paths in a single Undo step.

commands.title: Open crease settings
commands.description: Open the interactive CAD crease/perforation settings; does not apply changes.

commands.title: Configure crease or perforation
commands.description: Set manufacturing process for selected crease paths and subsequent new creases. Perforations require cut/tie lengths in mm. Metadata and vector layers do not simulate tearing or tool crushing.

commands.title: Inspect account board database
commands.description: Load the account board catalog and revision. Returns nominal defaults until the account saves its own records.

commands.title: Select board specification
commands.description: Select an account board for generation or apply its material snapshot to the selected linked box. Caliper comes from the record; selected-box changes support Undo.

commands.title: Edit board database CSV
commands.description: Open an interactive CSV editor. Save database explicitly persists the account catalog; opening does not write or alter existing models.

commands.title: Export board database CSV
commands.description: Return the account board catalog as editable CSV with canonical mm/gsm values; does not publish or download.

commands.title: Save account board CSV
commands.description: Validate and replace the signed-in account board catalog from CSV. Uses revision checking against concurrent edits. Does not retroactively change saved model material snapshots.

commands.title: Open packaging design
commands.description: Open interactive point-to-point cut/score drawing and board extrusion. Opening does not change the saved profile.

commands.title: Choose new path type
commands.description: Choose cut or score for the staged point-to-point path.

commands.title: Set packaging grid snap
commands.description: Set grid spacing in display units or explicit mm; zero disables snapping.

commands.title: Add draft point
commands.description: Add one point to the staged interactive path. Drafts are discarded when the dialog closes. Finish explicitly to save.

commands.title: Remove last draft point
commands.description: Remove the last staged point.

commands.title: Cancel draft path
commands.description: Discard the staged path without changing the saved design.

commands.title: Finish draft path
commands.description: Commit the staged cut/score path. Undo supported.

commands.title: Select packaging path
commands.description: Select a saved path for point editing and line assignment.

commands.title: Fit packaging drawing
commands.description: Fit the two-dimensional drawing without changing geometry.

commands.title: Inspect packaging profile
commands.description: Read canonical millimeter profile, board caliper and cut/score paths.

commands.title: Draw packaging path
commands.description: Add a point-to-point cut or score path; closed cut contours can be extruded. Coordinates use display units unless units=mm. Undo supported.

commands.title: Edit packaging path
commands.description: Edit points, closure or cut/score assignment of an existing path. Undo supported.

commands.title: Delete packaging path
commands.description: Remove an existing path. Undo supported.

commands.title: Set board caliper
commands.description: Set measured board thickness and grade label. Display units by default; nominal flute presets are editable approximations, not strength ratings. Undo supported.

commands.title: Name packaging profile
commands.description: Set the profile name used in downloaded filenames. Undo supported.

commands.title: Extrude board profile
commands.description: Add a solid board from closed nonintersecting cut contours and holes, with caliper along Y. Uses declared scene units; unknown scene units must be resolved first. Score lines remain crease metadata. Undo supported.

commands.title: Edit selected board profile
commands.description: Load the canonical profile stored on the selected packaging board into the dieline editor. Undo supported. Does not resize the existing solid.

commands.title: Export packaging vectors
commands.description: Return SVG or DXF contents in millimeters with separate CUT and SCORE layers. Does not download or publish.

commands.title: Download packaging vectors
commands.description: Download a local SVG or DXF file at physical millimeter scale. No remote publication.

commands.title: Inspect scene
commands.description: Return all objects, selected object ID and loading state.

commands.title: Select object
commands.description: Select an object by its stable ID.

commands.title: Activate model tool
commands.description: Activate selection, move, rotate or scale controls. Transform tools require a selected editable object; activating a tool does not change its transform.

commands.title: Transform object
commands.description: Set position in model units (or global display units when units=display), rotation in degrees, and scale. Omitted vectors stay unchanged. Undo supported.

commands.title: Duplicate object
commands.description: Duplicate and select an object. Returns the new ID. Undo supported.

commands.title: Array object
commands.description: Create a W/L/H array. Optional gap is edge spacing by width/length/height, in display units by default; unknown source units use model units. Zero gap makes copies touch. W=X, L=Z, H=Y. Animated reveal is on by default: sequential drops accelerate while the camera eases to the full array. Camera keyframes override auto-fit. Await completion; pause/resume/cancel via object.array.playback. One Undo step.

commands.title: Control array reveal
commands.description: Pause, resume or cancel an active array reveal while normal editing is blocked. Cancel restores the pre-array scene and camera.

commands.title: Inspect array reveal
commands.description: Read array creation/reveal state, progress, placed count and automatic camera state.

commands.title: Drop object to floor
commands.description: Move the object to the active ground plane using the current up vector. Undo supported.

commands.title: Set object dimension
commands.description: Set one W/L/H object dimension in the current global display unit. W=X, L=Z, H=Y. Undo supported.

commands.title: Set proportional scaling
commands.description: Choose whether manual W/L/H edits preserve object proportions.

commands.title: Scale by percentage
commands.description: Multiply current object dimensions uniformly by a positive percentage. Undo supported.

commands.title: Transform selected group
commands.description: Set the active object transform and apply its transform delta to all selected objects. Position is in current global display units by default. Undo supported.

commands.title: Group selected objects
commands.description: Group the selected objects for selection and transform controls. Group membership is saved in portable sessions. Undo supported.

commands.title: Ungroup selected objects
commands.description: Remove group membership while preserving placement. Undo supported.

commands.title: Preview polygon optimization
commands.description: Prepare seam-aware decimation for selected static objects without changing original geometry. Retained triangle percentage and relative error percentage are limits, not guaranteed reduction. Run polygon.apply explicitly to commit.

commands.title: Preview array decimation
commands.description: Prepare selected source decimation and return the projected array triangle counts without creating copies. Apply and array creation remain explicit.

commands.title: Open array preview tool
commands.description: Open the interactive array and decimation preview dialog. Does not create copies or change geometry.

commands.title: Apply polygon optimization
commands.description: Explicitly apply the prepared preview if the scene has not changed. Original geometry remains available through Undo.

commands.title: Cancel polygon preview
commands.description: Cancel background optimization and discard the staged preview.

commands.title: Open polygon optimizer
commands.description: Open interactive polygon preview and quality inspection. Opening the dialog does not change geometry.

commands.title: Set object user data
commands.description: Set a user-defined metadata field on an object. The field is stored in the Auto3D session.

commands.title: Set visibility
commands.description: Explicitly show or hide an object. Undo supported.

commands.title: Delete object
commands.description: Remove an object from this session. Recover with history.undo.

commands.title: Focus object
commands.description: Frame an object in the viewport.

commands.title: Fit scene
commands.description: Frame all visible objects.

commands.title: Set full screen
commands.description: Enter or exit browser full-screen mode.

commands.title: Undo
commands.description: Step through object edit history.

commands.title: Redo
commands.description: Step through object edit history.

commands.title: Set background
commands.description: Choose a viewport background preset.

commands.title: Set viewport guides
commands.description: Set horizon gradient and ground grid visibility.

commands.title: Set ambient fill, reflections and shadows
commands.description: Set ambient diffuse/specular fill, reflections and floor-shadow options using the same functions as the Lighting panel.

commands.title: Inspect shadow visibility
commands.description: Diagnose the shadow pipeline, effective original-model visibility, floor depth state, WebGL context and shader errors without changing the scene.

commands.title: Inspect lighting
commands.description: Return current environment and adjustments.

commands.title: Set lighting
commands.description: Apply a lighting configuration obtained from lighting.inspect.

commands.title: List materials
commands.description: Return material indices, properties and assigned texture names.

commands.title: Set material property
commands.description: Set a numeric surface property for a material index; preserves UVs and textures.

commands.title: Set base color
commands.description: Set a material base color using six-digit hex. Preserves assigned maps.

commands.title: Set theme
commands.description: Apply and remember a light or dark theme.

commands.title: Set display units
commands.description: Apply metric or standard display units.

commands.title: Set viewport quality
commands.description: Remember Auto, Fast or Quality display resolution. Original geometry and final render resolution are preserved.

commands.title: Inspect viewport quality
commands.description: Return effective display pixel ratio and interaction state without changing geometry.

commands.title: Replace texture image
commands.description: Replace a material map from a PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URI. Retains UVs and map placement.

commands.title: Inspect texture UV and effects
commands.description: Read assigned image name, UV tiling, offsets, rotation, emboss/deboss settings, spot varnish settings and automatic board-flute linkage. Does not return image bytes.

commands.title: Set texture UV mapping
commands.description: Set UV tiling, offsets or rotation in degrees using the texture preview service. Preserves image bytes. Nonzero tiling supports mirrored textures; one Undo step. Manual bump/normal placement disables automatic board-flute mapping.

commands.title: Apply spot varnish mask
commands.description: Mask gloss and reflectivity with local artwork. Preserves ink and relief; keeps original finish maps for disabling or reapplying. UV-relative mask placement, one Undo step, no CAD changes. Optional PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 mask up to 8 MB.

commands.title: Apply corrugated surface or die impression
commands.description: Build a visual-only bump map combining paper grain, flute impressions and optional emboss/deboss artwork. UV-relative spacing; preserves CAD geometry, color and normal maps. Optional PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 mask up to 8 MB is saved for further adjustments. One Undo step.

commands.title: Auto texture generator
commands.description: Derive missing local surface maps from base color, or a procedural surface. Preserves existing maps by default; overwrite regenerates auxiliary maps while retaining base color. One Undo step; fills wholly missing UVs.

commands.title: Preview texture and edit UV/effects
commands.description: Open an interactive large texture preview with coordinates, rotation, tiling, Save and Replace. Base/Bump/Normal previews include emboss/deboss masks; Gloss/Reflective previews include spot varnish masks. Opening does not apply edits.

commands.title: Save texture
commands.description: Download the original embedded image bytes. Does not upload.

commands.title: Remove texture
commands.description: Remove one texture map; Undo supported.

commands.title: Select relief mode
commands.description: Choose normal, bump or no relief without discarding either texture. Undo supported.

commands.title: Preview UV layout
commands.description: Open an interactive UV triangle layout dialog.

commands.title: Generate missing box UVs
commands.description: Fill wholly unmapped meshes using box projection; preserve authored coordinates. Undo supported.

commands.title: Search corrugated packaging knowledge
commands.description: Search Auto3D's curated corrugated-paper packaging knowledge base for FEFCO styles, board/flute specifications, material properties, strength metrics and design guidance.

commands.title: Read corrugated packaging section
commands.description: Read one complete section from Auto3D's corrugated packaging knowledge base.

commands.title: Open rendering
commands.description: Open PNG rendering controls in the left panel.

commands.title: Render scene now
commands.description: Render the main viewer scene and open the right render workspace. Returns immediately. Background mode permits camera navigation while scene edits pause.

commands.title: Queue PNG renders
commands.description: Queue the current screen, one saved camera or all saved cameras. Alpha exports only models. No remote upload or automatic download.

commands.title: Inspect render queue
commands.description: Read render job status, resolution and progress without image bytes.

commands.title: Start render queue
commands.description: Start sequential local PNG rendering. Background mode leaves camera navigation enabled. Returns immediately; inspect progress or cancel through queue commands.

commands.title: Stop rendering
commands.description: Cancel the active job at the next tile and leave pending jobs queued.

commands.title: Cancel render job
commands.description: Cancel one pending or active render job.

commands.title: Clear render queue
commands.description: Empty the session render queue and close its image windows. Set all false to remove only finished jobs. Active jobs cancel between tiles.

commands.title: Delete selected renders
commands.description: Delete selected session jobs, release image memory and close their image windows. Active jobs cancel between tiles.

commands.title: Open rendered image
commands.description: Open a completed PNG in an interactive separate image window with pan and zoom. Browser pop-up permission may be needed.

commands.title: Control rendered image view
commands.description: Inspect or control an already opened image popout. Fit, actual (100%), relative zoom factor, or pan in screen pixels. Does not alter the render or scene.

commands.title: Download rendered PNG
commands.description: Explicitly download one completed PNG to the local device. No remote upload.

commands.title: Minimize Details
commands.description: Collapse Details while keeping the render queue available underneath.

commands.title: Open camera settings
commands.description: Open the left Camera panel with FOV and named session views.

commands.title: Inspect saved cameras
commands.description: List named camera views saved in the current session.

commands.title: Orbit selected object
commands.description: Use the selected visible object world-space center as the orbit pivot. Keeps current camera position, framing and zoom; right-drag uses the same method after the drag threshold.

commands.title: Inspect current camera
commands.description: Read current camera position, target, orientation, projection and FOV, including during fold or array animation. Does not create a saved camera.

commands.title: Set camera field of view
commands.description: Set current camera FOV in degrees and update view framing. Stops camera playback.

commands.title: Save camera view
commands.description: Save current position, target, orientation, projection and FOV as a named session camera. Undo supported.

commands.title: Go to saved camera
commands.description: Restore a saved camera view and stop timeline playback. Works in read-only viewers.

commands.title: Update saved camera
commands.description: Replace a named camera with the current view, retaining its name and ID. Undo supported.

commands.title: Rename saved camera
commands.description: Rename a saved session camera. Undo supported.

commands.title: Delete saved camera
commands.description: Remove a saved camera from this session. Undo supported.

commands.title: Inspect keyframe timeline
commands.description: Return native Auto3D timeline duration, playhead, interpolation mode, camera keyframes and per-object keyframe counts.

commands.title: Open Action keyframe options
commands.description: Open the interactive Action dialog for the selected box at the current playhead. Does not add a keyframe until submitted.

commands.title: Add fold/unfold Action keyframe
commands.description: Add a procedural fold/unfold action for a generated box, evaluated by timeline time during playback and scrubbing. Rejects overlapping actions on the same box. Undo supported; CAD geometry is unchanged.

commands.title: Delete Action keyframe
commands.description: Delete a timeline action and reevaluate its pose, with Undo support.

commands.title: Inspect realistic board surface
commands.description: Read visual-only board bow, fold softness, cut compression and paper grain for the selected packaging model. CAD and manufacturing dimensions remain exact.

commands.title: Adjust realistic board surface
commands.description: Update the selected packaging visual surface. Preserves CAD geometry, authoritative measurements, array spacing and authored print/varnish maps. Automatic generated paper maps update with grain. Settings persist with the profile; Undo supported.

commands.title: Scrub box fold/unfold pose
commands.description: Set a visual fold pose from flat (0) to assembled (1). Commit saves the preview setting with one Undo step. Canonical CAD and measurements remain unchanged.

commands.title: Inspect selected box fold pose
commands.description: Read selected box visual fold progress without modifying CAD or geometry.

commands.title: Seek keyframe timeline
commands.description: Move the native Auto3D timeline playhead and evaluate object/camera tweening.

commands.title: Show Advance animation
commands.description: Reveal or close the bottom scene and camera timeline panel.

commands.title: Set animation range
commands.description: Set beginning and end markers in seconds within the timeline duration.

commands.title: Configure Advance animation
commands.description: Set duration, looping and tween interpolation for new keyframes.

commands.title: Control Advance animation playback
commands.description: Play, pause or reset the scene and camera sequence.

commands.title: Save scene state keyframe
commands.description: Capture every scene object placement at the current playhead.

commands.title: Delete animation keyframe
commands.description: Delete an existing camera or object keyframe by ID.

commands.title: Inspect embedded animation
commands.description: Read imported animation clips, durations, playback state and any load error.

commands.title: Control embedded animation
commands.description: Play, pause, reset or seek an imported GLB/glTF clip.

commands.title: Configure embedded animation
commands.description: Select a clip and set playback speed and looping.

commands.title: Save object keyframe
commands.description: Capture an object position, rotation and scale on the native timeline.

commands.title: Save camera keyframe
commands.description: Capture the current viewer camera position, target, orientation, FOV, azimuth and elevation on the native timeline.

commands.title: Edit visual macro
commands.description: Add, update, remove or reorder a visual macro step without executing it. Existing step IDs are preserved. Index is zero-based.

commands.title: List saved macros
commands.description: Return macros stored in this browser.

commands.title: Save macro
commands.description: Save a named version 1 macro locally. Definition is a JSON string; matching names are replaced.

commands.title: Open material editor
commands.description: Open the material editor for the selected object.

commands.title: Inspect application version
commands.description: Return the running application version and build identifier for release verification.

commands.title: Inspect saved viewport preferences
commands.description: Return account preference loading state and current background/grid/camera defaults, without credentials.

commands.title: Inspect unsaved recovery
commands.description: Validate this account's device recovery checkpoint and return its status/error without archive contents.

commands.title: Open recovery dialog
commands.description: Open the recovery dialog for an empty workspace, including a readable reason when no usable checkpoint exists. Interactive dialog.

commands.title: Restore unsaved recovery
commands.description: Restore a valid device checkpoint into an empty editable workspace. Retains the checkpoint until an explicit full-session save.

commands.title: Inspect preferences
commands.description: Return account theme and display units without private credentials.

commands.title: List account Library
commands.description: List private models and sessions belonging to the signed-in account.

commands.title: Save to account Library
commands.description: Explicitly upload the current session or selected model to the private account Library.

commands.title: Open account Library item
commands.description: Open or add an owned account archive to the editable workspace.

commands.title: Open or add saved Library model
commands.description: Load a saved account, device or published model through the same guarded service as the Library Open/Add buttons. Append preserves the current scene and records one Undo step.

commands.title: Open saved-model sharing
commands.description: Open an interactive Share dialog for a saved model. It defaults to a four-digit code and offers link/QR generation; opening does not upload.

commands.title: Create protected audience link
commands.description: Explicitly create a separate remote read-only snapshot of a saved model with a four-digit code, mini-viewer link and 1–90 day expiry. Device saves upload. The QR encodes only the URL. Server rollout must be enabled.

commands.title: List owned audience links
commands.description: List this account’s audience links and expiry/revocation status without access codes or model bytes.

commands.title: Revoke audience link
commands.description: Immediately revoke an owned audience link and release its remote snapshot file. Does not delete the original Library item.

commands.title: Inspect scene model groups
commands.description: Read group names, array membership, model counts and navigation expansion state.

commands.title: Expand or collapse model group
commands.description: Expand/collapse a group in the model list and mesh navigator without changing geometry or transforms.

commands.title: Rename account Library item
commands.description: Rename an owned item without uploading another archive.

commands.title: Move account Library item
commands.description: Move an owned item to a category/project folder.

commands.title: Delete account Library item
commands.description: Explicitly delete an owned saved archive and preview.

commands.title: Create account Library folder
commands.description: Create a private category/project folder.

commands.title: Rename account Library folder
commands.description: Rename a private folder and move its saved items. Multi-item changes may require retry after a network failure.

commands.title: Delete account Library folder
commands.description: Remove a private folder and move its files to the parent without deleting archives.

commands.title: Open library
commands.description: Open the saved-model library.

commands.title: Open save dialog
commands.description: Ask the user where to save. Destination defaults to file; account matches the header Save button. This command opens a dialog; it does not publish.

commands.title: Run typed commands
commands.description: Run supported phrases such as array model 4x4x6, fit, undo, or run macro Name. Semicolons run a sequence through the strict registry. Each action retains authentication, read-only and busy checks; saved macros may partially complete before a runtime failure. Does not accept arbitrary code.

commands.title: Open commands and macros
commands.description: Open the interactive command catalog and macro builder; does not execute commands.

commands.title: Open Packaging panel
commands.description: Open the independent Packaging module in its last minimal or extended mode. No model is generated.

commands.title: Inspect module panels
commands.description: Read registered module panel modes and visibility without changing content.

commands.title: Set module panel mode
commands.description: Set a registered module to minimal, extended or closed. Each module retains its own mode and controls; opening does not generate content.

commands.title: Inspect AI project
commands.description: Read creation history, preview selection and loaded model scales. Does not submit provider tasks.

commands.title: Refresh AI creations
commands.description: Load recent Meshy tasks without generating models.

commands.title: Preview AI creation
commands.description: Download and preview a task in the isolated AI viewer without changing the session.

commands.title: Set AI model scale
commands.description: Set the selected AI model scale retained on Add to session and Library save.

commands.title: Add AI creation to session
commands.description: Append the previewed model with textures and scale to the session. Does not close AI.

commands.title: Save AI project to Library
commands.description: Explicitly save all completed 3D creations, embedded textures, original GLBs and scales to private account Library. Downloads unpreviewed completed models; pending task assets are not saved.

commands.title: Open AI Library project
commands.description: Open an owned AI project archive inside the AI workspace without replacing the main session.

commands.title: Open AI project picker
commands.description: Open an interactive .auto3d AI project file picker. No file is opened until selected.

commands.title: Choose AI reference image
commands.description: Open the interactive PNG/JPEG/WebP reference image picker. Does not upload or generate until an explicit submission.

commands.title: Refine AI preview
commands.description: Explicitly submit a successful Text to 3D preview for PBR texturing using the workspace texture settings.

commands.title: Generate with Meshy
commands.description: Explicit paid-provider submission: text/image to 3D, text to image, texture, humanoid rigging or animation. Image actions use the reference selected interactively or the selected generated image. Returns queued task; progress appears in history.

commands.title: Open AI panel
commands.description: Open AI generation controls. Does not send a generation request.

commands.title: Open Packaging panel (legacy alias)
commands.description: Open the independent Packaging panel. Compatibility alias for ui.packaging; does not open AI.

commands.title: Open model picker
commands.description: Open a local file picker to add models. Requires interactive file selection.

commands.title: Open replacement model picker
commands.description: Open a local file picker to replace the selected model. Requires interactive file selection.

commands.title: Open export dialog
commands.description: Open the interactive export dialog. Does not export or publish until the user chooses a format.
